method: 2000 stratified biomass fractions; seeded categorical routes and independent uniform uncertainty draws
scope: Screening proxy using saved process/cost anchors and stated engineering assumptions; not validated BioSTEAM TEA, complete LCA, or a robust optimum. Default orthophosphate share is zero; N/P route has no struvite.
matched_basis: 30,000 t/y available; 50% processed; 5,160 h/y; all assumptions at range midpoints
financial_basis: 20 years, 8% discount; constant annual operating cash flow; partial capital/OPEX
gas_basis: Methane Nm3 at 273.15 K, 101325 Pa; sales dry product m3 at 293.15 K, 101325 Pa
